title: Work lands for items outside a started sprint and nothing flags it
goal: backlog.py check reports an item whose status is todo, doing or done while its sprint is planned (a planned sprint's items are draft until start), and kbgit.py check-trailers, run by the commit and pre-push hooks on commits not yet on origin/main, refuses a KB-Work id whose item is not claimed or is not in a started sprint (not in a started sprint), except the sprint, backlog-planning and review items themselves; every planned sprint's items are draft; each refusal has a planted failure in test_backlog.py; backlog.md states both rules.
notes: Failure it answers: commit 527223d landed TK-5s6ehtxp “Commit install-python.ps1 with a planted-conflict test and its docs” while its sprint SP-fep4fpsx “Windows ready” was planned, the task unclaimed and its dependency TK-cdoww36l open; check printed errors=0. Planned sprints also hold todo items (Windows ready, Ingestion maps code natively, Work has a measured cost and others) although the runbook keeps them draft until start. History stays as it is: check-trailers judges only commits not yet on origin/main.
